new_libraries.name: PinNode
new_libraries.author: PinNode
new_libraries.sentence: PinNode for RetroPinUpgrade games: scores, achievements, stats and settings to a PinNode node.
new_libraries.paragraph: The RPU-Link (UART for RPU Rev 4/102, SPI for future PinNode boards) and the PinNode API for Arduino Mega game code, plus the types for the pinnode-gen generated header.

new_libraries.name: Radio_GemTek
new_libraries.author: İsmail Caner Naz
new_libraries.sentence: Control a GemTek FM radio module using an Arduino.
new_libraries.paragraph: Programs the module's BU2614 frequency synthesizer and provides frequency, mute, PLL, and mono/stereo status controls. The communication protocol was reverse engineered and tested with a USB FM transmitter.

new_libraries.name: RPUMachines
new_libraries.author: PinNode and contributors
new_libraries.sentence: Machine definitions (lamps, switches, solenoids) for RetroPinUpgrade games.
new_libraries.paragraph: One header per machine, shared by every game written for it, with the manufacturer's names for each lamp, switch and coil.
